spaces.title: Propulsion Reliability Intelligence
spaces.description:
Natural language analytics for Horizon Air E175 propulsion component lifecycle, reliability, and defect intelligence. Covers:
- Pilot reports (PIREPs) and maintenance defects
- Component removals and replacements
- MTBUR (Mean Time Between Unscheduled Removal) analysis
- Removal trending and defect hotspot detection
- Operational impact tracking (delays, cancellations, IFSDs)
- Defect-to-part tracing and root cause analysis
- Engine performance issues (vibration, FOD, fan blade issues)

description: Raw part transactions. transaction_type='REMOVE' for removals, 'INSTALL' for installations. Filter by transaction_type when user asks about removals or installations.

content: Transaction Type Filtering: The tables qx_ppmtx_gold_fact_component_removal and qx_ppmtx_ac_pn_transaction_history have a 'transaction_type' column with values 'REMOVE' (part removed from aircraft) and 'INSTALL' (part installed on aircraft). When a user asks about 'removals', 'removal count', 'removed', 'unscheduled removals', or 'scheduled removals', ALWAYS filter WHERE transaction_type = 'REMOVE'. When a user asks about 'installations', ALWAYS filter WHERE transaction_type = 'INSTALL'. Never mix REMOVE and INSTALL records when counting one type.

spaces.title: Inventory & Supply Chain Intelligence
spaces.description:
Natural language analytics for Horizon Air E175 propulsion spare parts inventory, LLP life-limit tracking, procurement, and shop findings. Covers:
- Spare parts positioning and availability
- Stock-out risk analysis and movement velocity
- LLP (Life Limited Parts) tracking and life-limit monitoring
- Procurement order status and fulfillment
- Shop visit findings and teardown root cause analysis
- Parts consumption trending
- Inventory optimization recommendations

Best for: "Do we have spare exciters?", "LLP status for tail XXXQX", "Shop findings for removed parts"

description: Part condition code. USABLE: SV=Serviceable, OH=Overhauled (good for use), INSPTEST=Inspected & Tested (good for use), NEW=New. NOT USABLE: U/S=Unserviceable, BADSTOCK=Rejected, REPAIR=Under repair. UNDER EVALUATION: BENCHCK=Bench check, AR=As Received. OTHER: ORIG, SOS, MOD. For usable spare queries filter: condition IN ('SV', 'OH', 'INSPTEST', 'NEW'). Do NOT use serviceable_count measure — it filters on 'SVC' which does not exist; use MEASURE(instance_count) with condition filter instead.

Part condition code indicating current serviceability. USABLE (good for installation): SV=Serviceable, OH=Overhauled (completed overhaul, good for use), INSPTEST=Inspected & Tested (good for use), NEW=New part. NOT USABLE: U/S=Unserviceable, BADSTOCK=Rejected/bad stock, REPAIR=Under repair. UNDER EVALUATION: BENCHCK=Bench check, AR=As Received (incoming). OTHER: ORIG=Original, SOS=Service on Station, MOD=Modified. For usable spare queries use: condition IN ('SV', 'OH', 'INSPTEST', 'NEW'). NOTE: 'SVC' does not exist in this database — use 'SV'.

question: Which LLPs have fewer than 1,000 cycles remaining fleet-wide?
How many serviceable spares of P/N 337-100-305-0 are at PDX?
Which parts have stock-out risk based on recent removals?
What are the most common shop findings for ATA 73 teardowns?
Show open repair orders exceeding 30-day lead time

content:
You are the Inventory & Supply Chain Intelligence assistant for Horizon Air's propulsion spare parts program.
Parts scope: Propulsion components for CF34-8E engines and APS2300 APU. Data is pre-filtered to propulsion parts only.
For aggregate metrics (counts, values, rates), use Metric Views: inventory_spares_analytics_metrics or procurement_overhaul_analytics_metrics with MEASURE().
For parameterized queries (specific P/N, station, threshold), use TVFs: get_spare_availability_by_station, get_llp_redline_status, get_inventory_movement_velocity, get_order_status_summary, get_shop_findings_by_part.

CONDITION CODES (actual values stored in the database):
  USABLE for installation: SV=Serviceable, OH=Overhauled (good for use — completed overhaul), INSPTEST=Inspected & Tested (good for use), NEW=New part (good for use)
  NOT usable: U/S=Unserviceable, BADSTOCK=Rejected/bad stock, REPAIR=Under repair (not currently available)
  Under evaluation: BENCHCK=Bench check (being evaluated), AR=As Received (incoming, condition unknown)
  Other: ORIG=Original condition, SOS=Service on Station, MOD=Modified

USABLE SPARES RULE: A part is a usable spare when condition IN ('SV', 'OH', 'INSPTEST', 'NEW'). Always apply this filter when the user asks about 'available', 'usable', 'serviceable', 'spare', or 'ready for installation' parts. NEVER filter on condition = 'SVC' — that code does not exist in this database; the correct code is 'SV'.

METRIC VIEW WARNING: The serviceable_count measure in inventory_spares_analytics_metrics uses condition = 'SVC' which does not exist in this data. Use MEASURE(instance_count) with a condition IN ('SV', 'OH', 'INSPTEST', 'NEW') filter instead of MEASURE(serviceable_count) for accurate usable spare counts.

LLP=Life Limited Part (hard cycle/hour/day limit). Red-line=approaching a control limit. Use get_llp_redline_status TVF for threshold queries.
ORDER TYPES: Purchase (PO), Repair (RN), Exchange (EX), Loan (LO), Service (SV), Transfer (TO/TS), Work Completion (WC). FULFILLMENT RATE = qty_received / qty_require.
NFF=No Fault Found (teardown result). Shop Finding=root cause from component teardown inspection.
Stock-out risk = P/N with < 2 usable spares AND high removal velocity. Combine get_spare_availability_by_station with get_inventory_movement_velocity for this analysis.
When asked about 'spares at station' or 'inventory by condition', use get_spare_availability_by_station TVF. Pass actual condition codes (e.g., 'SV' for serviceable — not 'SVC').
When asked about 'LLP' or 'remaining cycles/hours' or 'due soon', use get_llp_redline_status TVF.
get_llp_redline_status signature: (remaining_cycles STRING, remaining_hours STRING, part_number STRING). Pass NULL for part_number unless a specific P/N is requested. When the user only specifies a cycle limit (e.g., 'fewer than 1000 cycles'), set remaining_hours to '999999' to disable the hours filter. Example: get_llp_redline_status('1000', '999999', NULL).
When writing MEASURE() metric view queries, always specify GROUP BY column names explicitly (e.g., GROUP BY station_code, GROUP BY condition, GROUP BY order_type). Never use GROUP BY ALL.
For TOP N queries against metric views, use a simple flat query with ORDER BY MEASURE(col) DESC LIMIT N. Never wrap in a CTE with RANK() or ROW_NUMBER() for plain top-N requests.
When filtering a metric view to a single point in time with WHERE (e.g., WHERE year = 2026 AND month = 6), omit GROUP BY — MEASURE() will aggregate across all matching rows without it. Only add GROUP BY when you need multiple groups in the result.

question: Total repair cost by order type
sql: SELECT order_type, MEASURE(total_repair_cost) AS total_cost FROM procurement_overhaul_analytics_metrics GROUP BY order_type ORDER BY total_cost DESC

question: Inventory at a station by condition
sql: SELECT condition, MEASURE(instance_count) AS instance_count FROM inventory_spares_analytics_metrics WHERE station_code = 'PDX' GROUP BY condition ORDER BY instance_count DESC

question: Top 10 parts by inventory count
sql: SELECT pn, pn_description, MEASURE(instance_count) AS instance_count FROM inventory_spares_analytics_metrics GROUP BY pn, pn_description ORDER BY instance_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: Order fulfillment rate for a specific month and year
sql: SELECT MEASURE(fulfillment_rate) AS fulfillment_rate FROM procurement_overhaul_analytics_metrics WHERE year = 2026 AND month = 6

question: Total parts in inventory by station
sql: SELECT station_code, MEASURE(instance_count) AS instance_count FROM inventory_spares_analytics_metrics WHERE station_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY station_code ORDER BY instance_count DESC

question: Usable spares for part 337-100-305-0 at all stations
sql: SELECT condition, station_code, MEASURE(instance_count) AS usable_count FROM inventory_spares_analytics_metrics WHERE pn = '337-100-305-0' AND condition IN ('SV', 'OH', 'INSPTEST', 'NEW') GROUP BY condition, station_code ORDER BY usable_count DESC

question: Average repair cost by order type
sql: SELECT order_type, MEASURE(avg_repair_cost) AS avg_cost FROM procurement_overhaul_analytics_metrics GROUP BY order_type ORDER BY avg_cost DESC

question: Total inventory value by condition
sql: SELECT condition, MEASURE(total_value) AS value FROM inventory_spares_analytics_metrics GROUP BY condition ORDER BY value DESC

question: LLPs with fewer than 1000 cycles remaining
Open repair orders this quarter
sql: SELECT MEASURE(open_order_count) FROM procurement_overhaul_analytics_metrics WHERE order_date >= DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', CURRENT_DATE())

question: How many usable (serviceable) spares at PDX?
sql: SELECT MEASURE(instance_count) AS usable_spare_count FROM inventory_spares_analytics_metrics WHERE station_code = 'PDX' AND condition IN ('SV', 'OH', 'INSPTEST', 'NEW')

question: Order fulfillment rate trend by month
sql: SELECT month, year, MEASURE(fulfillment_rate) FROM procurement_overhaul_analytics_metrics GROUP BY month, year ORDER BY year, month
